class.name: JRPGActorData
class.brief_description: An actor: a character the player controls.
class.description: Database entry for a playable character: its name and nickname, class, starting and maximum level, profile, images, starting equipment and traits. Images are stored as [code]uid://[/code] (or [code]res://[/code]) paths so the data does not depend on loaded textures.

method.name: get_start_level
method.description: Returns the level the actor starts a new game at: [member initial_level], but never above [member max_level].

members.member: Path of the image used for the actor in side-view battles.
Path of the actor's character sheet, used on the map.
ID of the actor's class in the classes table. [code]0[/code] means none.
Path of the actor's face portrait, used in menus and messages.
Item IDs equipped when the game starts, one per equipment slot in the order of [member JRPGTypesData.equip_types]. [code]0[/code] leaves a slot empty.
Level at which the actor starts, from 1 to [constant LEVEL_LIMIT].
Highest level the actor can reach, from 1 to [constant LEVEL_LIMIT].
A secondary title shown on the status screen.
Introductory text shown on the status screen.
Traits of this actor. Each trait is a [Dictionary] with [code]code[/code], [code]data_id[/code] and [code]value[/code] (rates in basis points, 10000 = 100%).

constants.constant: Highest level an actor can have.
